name: 39-idle-night-first-consumer
description: Dark room, nobody watching: the unwatched boot measurement is the idle entry, so the illuminator stays off from the boot verdict on and the AE reads the scene without it (noir 20000 against 500 lit). At t=300 someone lights the LED from outside (WebUI, cron): the lit level 500 is below day_gain, so the noir day rule would call day - the 'state' cross-check finds the LED lit, refuses the day verdict and re-asserts 'idle'. The first consumer at t=600 is answered from the running measurement: LED on at once (kick, not the next tick), no probe, no click; 60 s after it leaves the LED goes off again.

expect_log: boot: night confirmed by the silent probe
lit although timps switched it off
